yt_description:
Softr or Stackby? Softr is a great app layer. Stackby gives you the app layer and a real relational database underneath, plus 100,000 automation runs a month on Pro.

We compared Softr Professional with Stackby Pro on databases, apps, workflows, interfaces and AI field agents.

Softr Professional: $1,668 a year ($139/mo flat plan, billed annually).
Stackby Pro: $449 a year for 3 users.
That's 73% less.

Feature by feature
• Built for — Softr: portals & internal apps · Stackby: database + apps + portals
• Relational database — Softr: app-first, lighter data · Stackby: linked tables, lookups, rollups
• Records per database — Softr: plan-capped per app · Stackby: 100,000 on Pro
• Automation runs / month — Softr: plan-capped · Stackby: 100,000 on Pro
• Live API data & sync — Softr: via integrations · Stackby: API columns + sync connectors
• AI field agents in your data — Softr: AI app builder · Stackby: classify, extract, summarise

Stackby plans (3 users included, billed annually)
• Economy: $149/year (7,000 records per database, 1,000 automation runs/month, interfaces)
• Business: $299/year (50,000 records, 25,000 runs/month, interfaces, sync connectors)
• Pro: $449/year (100,000 records, 100,000 runs/month, interfaces with custom domain, enterprise access)
Every plan includes AI, API columns and interfaces/portals.

👉 Try Stackby free: https://stackby.com/signup
